# Getting started (guides)

This is the correct target for `guides/setup.md`'s `../getting-started/` link (same
directory as `setup.md`, since a normal page's rendered directory URL sits one level
below its source file). It is also the file the off-by-one bug would send
`guides/index.md`'s identical-looking link to, silently, because a same-named sibling
happens to exist here instead of only at the docs root.
